t: What Drought Response Database Is All About
title: What Drought Response Database Is All About
description: Drought response escalates by indicator: the US Drought Monitor's D0-D4 scale (abnormally dry to exceptional) triggers restrictions. Cape Town's Day Zero (2018) was averted by 50% usage cuts; Australia's Millennium Drought built desalination and recycling. Agriculture adapts with deficit irrigation and drought-tolerant varieties. The rule: restrict early by the monitor, not late by the reservoir.
